entry.content:
• (Cloud Storage) Removed gcloud storage buckets anywhere-caches pause command.
  • (Distributed Cloud Edge) Removed deprecated gcloud edge-cloud container vpn-connections command group.
entry.summary: The 'gcloud storage buckets anywhere-caches pause' command has been removed. Additionally, the deprecated 'gcloud edge-cloud container vpn-connections' command group is no longer available.
entry.title: Breaking Changes: Cloud Storage and Edge Cloud commands removed

entry.content:
• Updated gcloud CLI to support Python v3.15.
  • Updated Linux and Windows bundled Python to upgrade grpcio to 1.84.0 and remove setuptools.
entry.summary: The gcloud CLI has been updated to support Python v3.15. This update also includes an upgrade of grpcio to 1.84.0 and the removal of setuptools in the bundled Python for Linux and Windows.
entry.title: Google Cloud CLI: gcloud CLI updated

entry.content: • Added --agent-response-denial-message flag to gcloud ai semantic-governance-policies create and gcloud ai semantic-governance-policies update (and their beta equivalents) to set a custom message that is shown to end users when a policy denies a request.
entry.summary: You can now set a custom message for end users when an AI policy denies a request. This feature is available for creating and updating semantic governance policies using the `gcloud` command-line tool. The `--agent-response-denial-message` flag allows you to personalize the denial experience.
entry.title: AI Platform: Customizable denial messages for AI policies

entry.content: • Updated gcloud agent-registry bindings create to make --source-identifier optional.
entry.summary: The `gcloud agent-registry bindings create` command now allows for an optional `--source-identifier`, providing more flexibility when creating agent bindings. This update simplifies the process for users who may not always have a specific source identifier readily available.
entry.title: Agent Registry: Agent Registry: Optional Source Identifier

entry.content: • Promoted IAM Group user types to GA.
entry.summary: We are happy to announce that IAM group user types have been promoted to General Availability. This feature allows for more flexible and scalable management of user access within your organization.
entry.title: AlloyDB: IAM group user types now generally available

entry.content: • Updated help text for gcloud artifacts repositories create to clarify that custom remote repository URIs must use HTTPS.
entry.summary: The help text for `gcloud artifacts repositories create` has been updated. It now clarifies that custom remote repository URIs must use HTTPS for security and compatibility.
entry.title: Artifact Registry: Artifact Registry: Remote Repository URI Update

entry.content:
• Modified bq update --connection to allow clearing serviceDirectoryService on AWS and Azure cross-cloud connections by passing --service_directory_service='' (when this flag value is empty, BigQuery uses the public internet to query the data instead of Cross-Cloud Interconnect).
  • Updated bq mk --migration_workflow, bq show --migration_workflow, bq rm --migration_workflow, and bq ls --migration_workflow to skip unnecessary setup steps.
entry.summary: BigQuery has enhanced its connection management. The `bq update --connection` command now supports clearing the `serviceDirectoryService` for AWS and Azure cross-cloud connections, allowing BigQuery to use the public internet for data queries when needed. Additionally, commands related to migration workflows (`bq mk`, `bq show`, `bq rm`, `bq ls`) have been optimized to skip redundant setup steps.
entry.title: BigQuery: BigQuery connection updates

entry.content: • Added --worker-release flag to gcloud builds submit, gcloud builds worker-pools create, and gcloud builds worker-pools update to specify the worker release channel or version.
entry.summary: You can now specify the worker release channel or version using the `--worker-release` flag in Cloud Build. This flag is available for `gcloud builds submit`, `gcloud builds worker-pools create`, and `gcloud builds worker-pools update` commands. This feature allows for greater control over your build environment.
entry.title: Cloud Build: Control worker release versions

entry.content: • Promoted gcloud dataplex dbt to GA.
entry.summary: The integration between Cloud Dataplex and dbt (data build tool) has been promoted to General Availability. This allows users to leverage dbt's data transformation capabilities directly within Dataplex, streamlining data modeling and governance.
entry.title: Cloud Dataplex: Dataplex dbt integration now generally available

entry.content: • Added --multizone flag to gcloud dataproc clusters create and gcloud dataproc workflow-templates set-managed-cluster to allow creating a multi-zonal cluster where instances can be created across multiple zones within the region.
entry.summary: New flags allow you to create clusters across multiple zones within a region. This enables higher availability for your workloads.
entry.title: Cloud Dataproc: Create multi-zonal clusters

entry.content: • Made --network flag optional on gcloud beta filestore instances create to support Private Service Connect (PSC) with user-created-endpoint.
entry.summary: The `--network` flag is now optional when creating Filestore instances. This change enhances support for Private Service Connect (PSC) configurations, allowing for user-created endpoints. This provides greater flexibility in how you connect to your Filestore instances.
entry.title: Cloud Filestore: Filestore instance creation is now more flexible

entry.content:
• Added gcloud beta iap tcp add-iam-policy-binding which adds an IAM policy binding to an Identity-Aware Proxy TCP IAM resource, including Cloud Run tunnel resources.
  • Added gcloud beta iap tcp remove-iam-policy-binding which removes an IAM policy binding from an Identity-Aware Proxy TCP IAM resource, including Cloud Run tunnel resources.
  • Added gcloud beta iap tcp get-iam-policy which displays the IAM policy for an Identity-Aware Proxy TCP IAM resource, including Cloud Run tunnel resources.
  • Added gcloud beta iap tcp set-iam-policy which replaces the IAM policy for an Identity-Aware Proxy TCP IAM resource, including Cloud Run tunnel resources.
entry.summary: New gcloud commands are available to manage IAM policies for Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP) TCP resources, including those for Cloud Run tunnels. These commands allow you to add, remove, get, and set IAM policy bindings, providing granular control over access to your proxied applications.
entry.title: Cloud Identity-Aware Proxy: Manage IAP TCP IAM Policies

entry.content:
• Promoted gcloud lustre instances directory-policies command group to GA.
  • Added --target-version flag to GA gcloud lustre instances create and gcloud lustre instances update.
entry.summary: Cloud Managed Lustre has been updated with General Availability releases for key features, including directory policies and version targeting for instance creation and updates.
entry.title: Cloud Managed Lustre: Cloud Managed Lustre GA Updates

entry.content:
• Added --[no-]use-http2 flag to gcloud run instances deploy to configure whether to use HTTP/2 for connections to the instance.
  • Added support for custom URLs with --domain flag in gcloud beta run deploy.
  • Added gcloud beta run services ssh which starts a secure, interactive shell session with an instance of a Cloud Run service.
  • Added gcloud beta run instances ssh which starts a secure, interactive shell session with a Cloud Run instance.
  • Promoted type=ephemeral-disk in --add-volume flag to GA for gcloud run deploy, gcloud run jobs deploy, gcloud run worker-pools deploy, 'gcloud run jobs create, gcloud run jobs update, gcloud run services create, gcloud run worker-pools create, and gcloud run worker-pools update.
  • Promoted --scaling-cpu-target and --scaling-concurrency-target flags to the GA track for gcloud run deploy and gcloud run services update.
  • Changed the maximum accepted value of the --scaling-cpu-target flag from 0.95 to 0.90 to match the Cloud Run API.
entry.summary: The latest Cloud Run update brings enhanced control over instance connections with the --[no-]use-http2 flag, custom URL support via the --domain flag, and secure SSH access to service instances. Additionally, ephemeral disk support and scaling targets have been promoted to General Availability.
entry.title: Cloud Run: New features for Cloud Run services

entry.content:
• Added gcloud alpha|beta tasks batch-create command, which creates multiple tasks from a JSON or YAML file in a single batch operation.
  • Added --from-file and --failed-tasks-file to gcloud alpha|beta tasks delete, which delete multiple tasks in a single batch operation.
  • Added the task-level retry flags --max-attempts, --max-retry-duration, --min-backoff, --max-backoff, and --max-doublings to gcloud alpha|beta tasks create-http-task and gcloud alpha|beta tasks create-app-engine-task. These flags override the queue-level retry configuration for an individual task.
entry.summary: Manage Cloud Tasks more efficiently with new batch operations for creating and deleting multiple tasks. You can now also configure task-level retries for individual tasks, overriding queue-level settings.
entry.title: Cloud Tasks: New batch operations for Cloud Tasks

entry.content: • Added regional endpoint support for gcloud workstations.
entry.summary: Cloud Workstations now supports regional endpoints for `gcloud workstations`. This enhancement allows for more localized and efficient management of your workstations.
entry.title: Cloud Workstations: Cloud Workstations regional endpoints

entry.content:
• Added <get|set>-iam-policy and <add|remove>-iam-policy-binding to gcloud beta compute ssl-policies.
  • Promote --kms-key flag for gcloud compute snapshots create to v1.
  • Promoted gcloud compute interconnects set-name to GA.
  • Added --instance-flexibility-policy flag for gcloud compute instances bulk create command in beta.
  • Added min-cpu-platform field in --instance-selection flag of gcloud compute instances bulk create in beta.
  • Updated gcloud compute image-views list to query public image projects by default and filter out deprecated images.
  • Added --standard-images, --preview-images, and --show-deprecated flags to gcloud compute image-views list.
entry.summary: New features and GA promotions for Compute Engine commands in gcloud, including IAM policy management for SSL policies, snapshot KMS key promotion, interconnect name setting, and enhancements to instance bulk creation and image viewing.
entry.title: Compute Engine: Compute Engine gcloud Updates

entry.content:
• Promoted --priority and --associated-policy-to-be-replaced flags of gcloud compute network-firewall-policies associations create to GA.
  • Promoted gcloud compute network-firewall-policies associations update command to GA.
entry.summary: We're happy to announce that the `--priority` and `--associated-policy-to-be-replaced` flags for creating firewall policy associations, as well as the `update` command for firewall policy associations, have now reached General Availability. This means these features are production-ready and available for use.
entry.title: Compute Firewall Policies: Firewall policy association updates

entry.content:
• Added --locale flag to gcloud device-run sessions submit xctest to switch the application locale before running tests.
  • Promoted gcloud device-run sessions submit android-executable to beta.
entry.summary: You can now switch application locales with the --locale flag for xctest sessions. The android-executable command has also been promoted to beta.
entry.title: Device Run: New device run features

entry.content: • Promoted gcloud network-security rate-limit-policies to beta.
entry.summary: We are excited to announce that network security rate limit policies have been promoted to beta. This new feature allows you to better protect your applications by controlling the rate of incoming traffic. With rate limiting, you can prevent abuse and ensure the availability of your services.
entry.title: Network Security: Network security rate limits reach beta

entry.content: • Added --[no-]deletion-notifications-enabled flag to gcloud scc bqexports create, gcloud scc bqexports update, gcloud scc notifications create, and gcloud scc notifications update to configure whether notifications are sent for deleted findings.
entry.summary: You can now control whether notifications are sent when findings are deleted. Use the new --[no-]deletion-notifications-enabled flag in bqexports and notifications commands to manage this setting.
entry.title: Security Command Center: Configure Deletion Notifications for Findings

entry.content:
• Added --dense-scann-target-recall to gcloud vector-search collections data-objects search to accept a query-time target recall (a value in [0, 1]) for dense index search.

Subscribe to these release notes at https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/google-cloud-sdk-announce.
entry.summary: The `gcloud vector-search collections data-objects search` command now accepts `--dense-scann-target-recall` for query-time tuning of dense index search recall. This allows users to specify a target recall value between 0 and 1 to influence search results.
entry.title: Vector Search: Vector Search recall tuning
